integrity_notes: An exact analytic proof and reproducible, limited finite rational checks are supplied; no independent validation or certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two types and two exchangeable collectors; each arrival time is independent, atomless and finite.
The arbitrary-law theorem is not asserted for dependent or discrete/tied clocks.
Unlocated general ordering theorems may contain equivalent implications; independent priority assessment remains outstanding.
title: Sharp heterogeneous two-type ballot probabilities for independent first-arrival clocks
